why: Holmes says at ¶231 that they are at Clapham Junction, so the place is named in the story so far.
¶231 says 'we shall be in Victoria in less than ten minutes', so Victoria is the stated destination.
The return journey to London is described as 'that evening' right after the Winchester race (¶215), and ¶231 places them at Clapham Junction on that journey.
